# AND Academy

> > AND Academy is a comprehensive online design education platform offering professional certificates, diplomas, and postgraduate programs in graphic design, interior design, and UI/UX design with job placement support.

AND Academy specializes in industry-relevant design education using professional tools like Adobe Creative Suite and Figma. The platform combines theoretical design fundamentals with hands-on portfolio development and career support across three major design disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Graphic Design
- Interior Design
- UI/UX Design
- Adobe Creative Suite
- Figma
- Portfolio Building
- Job Guarantee
- Design Fundamentals
- Career Support
- Online Learning
- Certificate Programs
- Diploma Courses
- Postgraduate Programs
- Motion Graphics
- Visual Design

## Graphic Design Programs

- [Graphic Design Bootcamp Online for Beginners](https://www.andacademy.com/graphic-design-courses/graphic-design-bootcamp): Graphic design bootcamp for beginners using Adobe tools and industry-relevant design concepts
- [Graphic Design Certificate Course Online](https://www.andacademy.com/graphic-design-courses/certificate-in-graphic-design): 5-month graphic design certificate with Adobe software mastery and placement support
- [Graphic Design Diploma Course Online](https://www.andacademy.com/graphic-design-courses/diploma-in-graphic-design): 9-month graphic design diploma with job guarantee and hands-on Adobe tools training
- [Graphic Design PG Diploma Course Online](https://www.andacademy.com/graphic-design-courses/pg-diploma-graphic-design-part-time): Part-time PG diploma in graphic design with job guarantee and brand communication focus

## UI/UX Design Programs

- [UI Design Certificate Online Course](https://www.andacademy.com/ui-ux-design-courses/ui-design-certificate): UI design certificate using Figma and Adobe tools with hands-on portfolio development
- [Diploma in UI UX Design Course Online](https://www.andacademy.com/ui-ux-design-courses/diploma-ui-ux-design): 9-month UI/UX design diploma with screen design fundamentals and career readiness
- [PG Diploma in UI UX Design Course Online](https://www.andacademy.com/ui-ux-design-courses/pg-diploma-ui-ux-design): 14-month PG diploma in UI/UX design with AI and Gestalt theory integration

## Interior Design Programs

- [Diploma in Interior Design Course Online](https://www.andacademy.com/interior-design-courses/diploma-in-interior-design): Interior design diploma covering residential design, spatial planning, and Vastu Shastra
- [PG Diploma in Interior Design Course Online](https://www.andacademy.com/interior-design-courses/pg-diploma-in-interior-design): PG diploma in interior design with residential and commercial design specialization
- [Interior Design Placements: Internships & Full-time Opportunities](https://www.andacademy.com/interior-design-placement): Interior design placement support with internships and full-time job opportunities

## Learning Resources & Community

- [Online Design Courses: Graphic Design, Interior Design, UI UX Design](https://www.andacademy.com): AND Academy homepage showcasing online design courses in graphic, interior, and UI/UX design
- [Student Works Showcase - Unveiling Design Excellence](https://www.andacademy.com/student-work): Student portfolio showcase featuring graphic, interior, and UI/UX design projects
- [AND Academy Design Blog - Learn, Discover & Get Inspired](https://www.andacademy.com/resources): Design blog with how-to guides, career advice, and trends across all design disciplines
- [Overview of Upcoming and Past Design Events](https://www.andacademy.com/events): Design events calendar including webinars, workshops, and masterclasses by experts
